baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction "did you reckon ... among Our signs a wonder" joins an observer's estimate to membership in a larger class of signs.
baseline_models.mechanism: Provisional reckoning classifies a rare event within the wider field of visible signs. The question does not erase wonder; it challenges the observer's ranking of this case as uniquely or maximally wondrous.

activation_trace.role: Supposition supplies the observer-side estimate whose adequacy the question tests.
A manifest sign supplies the comparison class into which the cave event is placed.
An unfamiliar or rare matter supplies the felt anomaly whose relative rank is recalibrated.

changed_reading.before: The ayah simply labels the cave companions an astonishing sign.
changed_reading.after: The ayah questions the observer's ranking of their case as exceptionally astonishing within a much wider field of signs.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The company is syntactically bound to both the cave and al-raqim.
baseline_models.mechanism: Companionship supplies durable attachment, the cave supplies refuge, and al-raqim supplies an inscription. Together they permit a two-channel preservation model: persons are retained in a place and made recoverable through a mark or record.

activation_trace.role: Companionship and continued attachment bind the people to the preserving media named after them.
Refuge supplies the enclosing physical channel of preservation.
A written line, register, or marked text supplies a second channel that can preserve identity across absence.

changed_reading.before: The cave and al-raqim are two opaque labels attached to a famous group.
changed_reading.after: The pair can present a preservation archive in which enclosure retains the company and inscription keeps it legible.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence joins reckoning, a written register, past occurrence, and wonder.
baseline_models.mechanism: Counting and recording turn an occurrence in time into a manageable historical object. The question places that act of calculation and registration under scrutiny before it accepts the resulting judgment of wonder.

activation_trace.role: Counting and calculation supply the procedure by which the event is measured.
The written register supplies a durable output of calculation and historical ordering.
Occurrence in past time supplies the event that the observer converts into a recordable history.

changed_reading.before: Wonder belongs transparently to the past event itself.
changed_reading.after: The ayah also foregrounds the observer's construction of a counted, recorded history and questions whether that construction yields adequate understanding.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context moves from an ordered written book to a sequentially delivered report explicitly qualified by correspondence to reality. This strengthens al-raqim as one component in an evidentiary chain: a mark preserves, while ordered truthful telling makes the preserved matter intelligible.

activation_trace.role: The inscribed register supplies the focus ayah's durable but not self-interpreting record.
Ordered letters and the written book establish writing as a truth-bearing medium in the immediate context.
Sequentially conveying a report supplies the operation that turns retained traces into an ordered account.
A report that arrives and is conveyed supplies transmission across the company's absence.
Stable correspondence with reality supplies the criterion by which the transmitted record is verified.

structural_cues: 18:5 contrasts absence of knowledge with speech characterized as false.
18:6 places remaining traces beside a renewed discourse before 18:13 announces the ordered report as true.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies writing, trace, transmitted report, and explicit truth qualification; I infer an arrow from retained mark to verified narration. A live alternative is that al-raqim remains only a proper designation or place and contributes no record function.

changed_reading.before: Al-raqim is merely a parallel label or a passive inscription beside the cave.
changed_reading.after: Al-raqim can be the durable record-stage of an archive whose preserved matter is recovered through ordered, truth-governed telling.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate prelude converts displayed surface beauty into stripped, vegetationless ground. Against that reversal, the mountain cavity and the land-mark branch of al-raqim can function as negative and residual forms that remain legible when surface display disappears.

activation_trace.role: The broad mountain cavity supplies a durable negative space within the terrain.
A marked trace in land or place supplies the residual surface record paired with the cavity.
Displayed beautification supplies the mutable surface layer that initially attracts attention.
The face of the earth supplies the exposed substrate after the display is removed.
Land cut off from vegetation supplies the erasure event against which cavity and trace persist.

structural_cues: 18:7-8 immediately precedes the focus question and reverses adorned earth into bare ground.
The focus follows that reversal with a cave and a term whose inventory includes a trace in land or place.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies surface adornment, stripped ground, a cave, and a land-mark branch; I infer that recess and trace are contrasted with erasable display. The alternative is a general comparison among divine signs with no specific archival relation.

changed_reading.before: The cave and al-raqim are static scenery or names.
changed_reading.after: They can form an erasure-resistant terrain archive, making the sign what remains legible after attractive surface conditions are stripped away.

context_deltas.mechanism: The cave gathers fugitives, yet the later language is of opening, benefit, a widened interior, and solar movement that veers and passes to either side. Refuge is therefore revised from a sealed container into a selectively permeable spatial system that protects while admitting livable extension.

activation_trace.role: Refuge supplies the protective boundary whose mode of operation the context specifies.
Joining a gathering shelter supplies inward movement and collective enclosure.
Opening, spreading, and branching supply the counter-movement by which refuge becomes expansive rather than merely closed.
Practical benefit supplies the life-serving outcome of the prepared refuge.
Veering aside supplies one directional component of controlled solar exposure.
Traversing a place to its side supplies the complementary solar bypass around the occupants.
A widened interval between boundaries supplies the interior geometry that permits protected openness.

structural_cues: The cave recurs as destination in 18:10 and as the location of suspension in 18:11.
In 18:17 the occupants are in a widened interior while the sun changes its relation to the cave at rising and setting.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies gathering, spreading benefit, a widened interior, and two-sided solar bypass; I infer that cave topology mediates preservation. A live alternative is that every protective effect is independent divine action and the spatial details are descriptive rather than causal.

changed_reading.before: The cave preserves by sealing the company away from the world.
changed_reading.after: The cave preserves as a selective boundary: it gathers and shields while its interior and solar relations sustain a livable opening.

context_deltas.mechanism: Counting years and exhaustively reckoning duration lead to the exact return of hasiba in a perception that is explicitly wrong: they are reckoned awake while asleep. Later numerical claims are characterized as conjectural casting toward what is hidden. Calculation and record remain useful, but they cannot by themselves authorize the observer's judgment of the sign.

activation_trace.role: Calculation supplies the initial method by which the observer tries to size the wonder.
The register supplies the durable numerical or documentary form that can invite confidence in calculability.
Enumeration makes the years an explicit object of counting.
Exhaustive numerical reckoning turns the unknown duration into a test of competing calculations.
The repeated supposition mirrors the focus verb and exposes a concrete appearance-based misclassification.
Wakefulness supplies the state inferred from outward appearance.
Sleep and stillness supply the contrary actual state that defeats the inference.
Speaking by conjecture about the unseen diagnoses ungrounded numerical claims as projection rather than knowledge.
What is screened from sight supplies the limit that counting claims overreach.

structural_cues: 18:19 has the awakened company estimate their stay as a day or part of a day.
18:22 enumerates rival totals, then restricts dispute and outside inquiry.
18:25 supplies a long numbered duration, while 18:26 closes by assigning superior knowledge of their stay to God.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated counting, the exact return of hasiba, an explicit appearance-reality reversal, and conjecture about the hidden; I infer that 18:9 targets epistemic overconfidence in calculability rather than rejecting number or record. The alternative is that these are separate narrative details and the focus question only compares marvels.

changed_reading.before: The question asks only whether this episode is unusually marvelous.
changed_reading.after: The question also asks whether a counted, recorded, and visually inferred account licenses the observer's ranking; the sign discloses the limits of reckoning itself.

context_deltas.mechanism: The hidden company is made discoverable so that a true promise becomes known, and the site immediately becomes an object of construction. The cave-record pair therefore gains a public evidentiary afterlife: preservation can verify, but its material witness can also be socially appropriated and monumentalized.

activation_trace.role: The manifest sign supplies the focus ayah's capacity to make something known beyond the preserved company.
A marked place supplies the focus-side substrate for later public recognition and commemoration.
Discovery of what was hidden converts private preservation into public evidence.
Disclosure to a knower supplies the stated epistemic outcome while retaining a contrast between human and fuller knowledge.
Correspondence with reality supplies what the discovered evidence confirms.
Constructing by joining materials supplies the social conversion of witnessed site into built memorial.

structural_cues: 18:21 explicitly links discovery of the company to others coming to know.
The same ayah moves immediately from evidentiary discovery to disagreement over what should be built above them.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies discovery, knowledge, truth confirmation, and subsequent building; I infer an arrow from preserved site to public witness and then to memorial appropriation. The alternative is that the building episode is only later social response with no semantic relation to al-raqim.

changed_reading.before: The cave and al-raqim preserve a private marvel from the past.
changed_reading.after: Their preservation can mature into public evidence of a true promise, while the same evidence-bearing site becomes vulnerable to contested monumental use.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because "companions" ordinarily denotes the human cohort. It remains anchored because the focus inventory includes preservation by accompaniment and making one thing accompany another, while 18:18 adds an extended dog to the preserved cave arrangement. Downstream prose should present this only as a relational or ecological activation, not as a claim that the dog is grammatically included in the phrase "companions of the cave."
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The companionship root can describe preservation through accompaniment and making elements remain attached to one another.

activation_trace.role: Preservation through accompaniment supplies a relational mechanism rather than a merely demographic group label.
Making one thing accompany and fit another supplies the distributed attachment among occupants, shelter, and attendant presence.
Refuge supplies the shared spatial participant that holds the companionship relation together.
The dog supplies a nonhuman accompanying presence within the preserved scene.
Bodily extension supplies the dog's stable spatial participation in the arrangement.

changed_reading.before: The companions are only a bounded human cast located in a cave.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, companionship can name a distributed preservation relation in which the human company, refuge, and accompanying nonhuman presence hold distinct roles.

strongest_changes: The return of hasiba in 18:18, where appearance yields the wrong state, turns the focus question into a critique of overconfident reckoning.
Repeated writing, truthful sequential report, discovery, and knowledge turn the cave-al-raqim pair into a two-channel archive with a public evidentiary afterlife.
Gathering, spreading benefit, widened interior, and two-sided solar bypass revise the cave from sealed shelter to selectively permeable refuge.
summary.what_was_special: The packet repeatedly joins preservation to problems of measurement and legibility: bodies remain while perception fails, durations are counted while knowledge is limited, and a sheltered site becomes both record and public witness.
remaining_uncertainties: Al-raqim may function as inscription, marked landscape, or an opaque designation; the packet does not force one.
The semantic link between al-raqim and the later building episode remains inferential rather than explicit.
The distributed-companionship outlier is a relational activation and should not be promoted into a grammatical identification.
